claims.evidence: Witness only saw boxed packaging with partial text “FRANCISODETOIA”; no view of the actual device or any copier/multifunction features.
No product surface/condition was visible—only the boxed item wrapped in clear plastic and taped.
No power-on test, output sample, or working demonstration was shown.

risks.risk: The item may not be a copier/multifunction printer at all (could be unrelated boxed goods), since the actual product is not visible.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the device outside the box showing the brand/model label and the control panel/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown boxed item with no confirmed function (worst-case: non-copier/untested).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model/variant is unreadable; compatibility and performance depend on the model.
risks.proof: A close-up screenshot/photo of the model number/spec label on the unit (and any included manual/spec sheet).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for unknown/untested boxed electronics, assuming no ability to verify specs.

risks.risk: Condition and completeness (missing parts, toner/ink, trays, cables, manuals) cannot be verified through packaging.
risks.proof: A photo checklist after opening: included accessories (power cable, USB/network cable, toner/ink, drum/unit if applicable) laid out and counted.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/possibly missing accessories (worst-case: buyer must replace consumables/cables).

risks.risk: Working status is unknown; copier/printer may be faulty, jam-prone, or have dead components.
risks.proof: A short video of power-on and a test print/copy showing a page coming out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until demonstrated.

risks.risk: Packaging text “FRANCISODETOIA” is only partially visible and may be misleading; could indicate a different product or generic packaging.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full branding/label on the box and the matching label on the device itself.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially misrepresented item (worst-case: cannot confirm identity).

proof_requests: Open the box and show the actual copier/multifunction device (front panel, brand/model label, and ports).
Provide a close-up of the exact model/variant and specifications label.
Show all included accessories laid out (power cable, toner/ink, manuals, network/USB cables, trays).
Power it on and record a short test: copy/print output page clearly visible.
Show any warranty/purchase proof or service history documents.
response.reason: The witness report shows only boxed packaging with partial text and no view of the actual copier or any working test. Without proof of identity and functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
